heading: Sunday
text: Scattered morning snow showers in the north and mountains, becoming spotty snow or rain showers, mainly across the higher terrain. Dry with pockets of sun in the southern valleys. Highs in the 30s to near 40 north, in the low to mid 40s in the Champlain Valley and south. Northwest wind at 10 to 15 mph.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Mostly cloudy through the north and mountains. Occasional clearing in southern valleys. Lows in the 20s to near 30. Light northwest wind.

heading: Monday
text: Mostly cloudy through the north and mountains. Increasing sun south to north. Highs from the upper 30s to low 40s in the north, increasing into the mid to upper 40s in the south.
